verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly lists 'Sprints' as a core product feature alongside Automations, Time Tracking, and task management (clickup-docs-15, clickup-docs-14, clickup-docs-12), and community discussion confirms robust task/status configuration typical of agile workflows (clickup-comm-1). However, the evidence pack gives no detail on sprint-specific mechanics (backlog, story points, burndown/velocity charts, sprint retrospectives) and no independent hands-on validation of the Sprints feature specifically. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sprint planning mechanics, independent/hands-on corroboration of the Sprints feature working well in practice.
